problems: The ring renders almost white, the same tone as the cream belts. It doesn't read as pale yellow, and on the left the upper belt seems to run into the ring. A deeper pale yellow keeps the ring separate from the belts.

The crater looks like a porthole or window, not a crater. It is a flat glossy cyan disc sitting proud of the surface inside a neat raised ring, and on a sci-fi card the restyle will likely turn it into a glass hatch. A crater should be a shallow matte blue hollow, sunk into the surface, with a low soft rim that blends into the planet.
